posts.title: Process Knowledge: Can America Relearn How to Make Things?
posts.description: TSMC is teaching Arizona to make chips America invented. For decades American companies taught Asia how to build what America designed. In Phoenix the lesson now runs the other way, and that makes it a key piece of US competitiveness in technology.
